description: This file defines the Goteo\Library\Newsletter class, which includes methods for generating SQL queries related to testing, recipients, and donors, as well as content rendering functions for newsletters. It appears integral to newsletter management in the Goteo project.

classes.name: Newsletter
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to generate SQL queries for targeting newsletter recipients such as testers, active receivers, and donors, and a method for generating newsletter HTML content with dynamic project and blog post inserts.

methods.name: getTestersSQL
methods.description: Returns an SQL string to fetch testers based on language preferences.

methods.name: getTesters
methods.description: Fetches a list of testers or a count of testers, with pagination support.

methods.name: getReceiversSQL
methods.description: Returns an SQL string to fetch active receivers who haven't blocked mailing and match language preferences.

methods.name: getReceivers
methods.description: Fetches a list of current newsletter receivers or counts, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getDonorsSQL
methods.description: Returns an SQL string to fetch donors based on language preferences and investments within the current or next calendar year.

methods.name: getDonors
methods.description: Fetches a list of donors or a count thereof, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Generates newsletter HTML content with dynamically inserted promoted projects and optional blog posts, supporting different languages and theme context.
